answer: Each epoch, a beacon hands every identity its own anchor word, say willow, and it must post a fresh sonnet whose ninth line ends on that word within ten minutes. Entries sharing over 30% of word trigrams with another are voided, so a template with swapped words fails. At 20 GPU-seconds per sonnet, 1,000 heads need 34 GPUs running all window. With 30, about 100 heads miss the deadline. Money still buys heads; it just buys fewer.
